name: EPS Creative Health Technology Group Limited
summary: EPS Creative Health Technology Group Limited is an investment holding company founded in 1999 and based in Hung Hom, Hong Kong, owned by EPS Holdings, Inc. and formerly Speed Apparel Holding Limited. Its garment segment manages knitwear supply chains for apparel brands in Hong Kong, China, Japan, the United States and Europe, from trend analysis to sourcing, production and logistics. Its healthcare segment develops new drugs and provides research organization and medical consultancy services.
